## Demo Scenario — Scania AB

The full demo uses the Scania R-series heavy truck supply chain seeded into Neo4j from `example_outputs/sample_graph.cypher` (2,305 lines, v10).

```
Scania R-series Truck
  └─► Scania AB (manufacturer, Sweden)
        ├─► ZF Friedrichshafen (gearboxes, Germany) — Tier 1
        │     └─► Saarstahl AG (steel billets, Germany) — Tier 2
        ├─► Bosch (fuel injection, electronics, Germany) — Tier 1
        │     ├─► Infineon Technologies (semiconductors, Germany) — Tier 2
        │     └─► Sensata Technologies (sensors, Netherlands) — Tier 2
        ├─► SSAB (high-strength steel, Sweden) — Tier 1
        │     └─► LKAB (iron ore, Sweden) — Tier 2
        ├─► Michelin (tyres, France) — Tier 1
        ├─► Dana Incorporated (axles, driveshafts, USA) — Tier 1
        └─► Cummins (engines for some variants, USA) — Tier 1
```

Cypher v10 adds the autonomous truck AI chain:
- **SCANIA-AXL** Level 4 truck — NVIDIA, Mobileye, Luminar (DISTRESS), Knorr-Bremse
- **Tier 2:** TSMC (Taiwan risk), ARM Holdings (SINGLE_SOURCE), ASML (export controls)
- **Tier 3:** JSR Corporation (EUV photoresist), Cryoin Engineering (Ukraine neon, seized)
- **17 events** total including NVIDIA export controls 2023, neon shortage 2022

### Load the demo graph

```bash
NEO4J_PW=$(python3 -c "
from pykeepass import PyKeePass
kp = PyKeePass('passwords.kdbx', password='SupplyChainBaby100!')
print(kp.find_entries(title='Neo4j', first=True).password)
")

scp -o ProxyJump=root@10.0.0.16 \
  example_outputs/sample_graph.cypher \
  root@10.0.1.114:/tmp/

ssh -o ProxyJump=root@10.0.0.16 root@10.0.1.114 \
  "cypher-shell -u neo4j -p '$NEO4J_PW' --file /tmp/sample_graph.cypher"
```
